messages:
incident-bot: PAGER | P1 - LynxCorp (enterprise / VPC) - function-call parser errors causing 5xxs across dedicated pool. Impacting customer checkout flows. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/fncall-parser-incident 

alice (oncall): ack oncall here, looking

ben (eng-sre): paging details? any pattern in the 500s?

incident-bot: First seen 17:12 UTC. Error signature: "jsonpath parser: unexpected token". Affected pool tag: dedicated-us-east-2-lynx. Error rate ~6% of Lynx requests, spike started after parser image rollout at 16:58 UTC.

carla (customer-success): Lynx SRE pinged us — customer-facing errors on checkout. They want ETA and mitigation ASAP.

dinesh (eng-runtime): I can push a compatibility shim or roll parser image back. Shim might take ~20m to build+test, rollback ~10m. Which do we want?

eva (platform): We have a pinned stable image: `registry.redwood.io/parser:v1.4.2`. Current rollout is `v1.5.0-rc`. Rolling back to v1.4.2 is fastest and low-risk.

alice (oncall): We should also isolate tenant traffic while we fix — route Lynx to a fallback pool to reduce blast radius. Ben, can you configure routing override?

ben (eng-sre): Yes. We have `fallback-dedicated-2` in us-east-2. Routing override will take ~3-4m to propagate and will cause cold-starts. Approving if customer OK.

carla (customer-success): Approved by Lynx SRE over DM. They prefer rollback + routing for minimal feature loss. :thumbsup:

dinesh (eng-runtime): Starting rollback + routing override now. Steps I'm running: 
```
# rollback parser image on the Lynx dedicated daemonset
kubectl -n inference set image ds/parser parser=registry.redwood.io/parser:v1.4.2 -l pool=dedicated-us-east-2-lynx
# apply routing override for tenant lynx to fallback pool for 10 minutes
redwoodctl route override --tenant lynx --pool fallback-dedicated-2 --ttl 600
```

alice (oncall): Heads-up: rolling back will remove some jsonpath extensions shipped in v1.5.0-rc — Lynx said that's acceptable for now. Notify them of missing features.

frank (support): I've notified Lynx SRE and product manager. Lynx responded: "We accept rollback, please send schema diff when available."

ben (eng-sre): Sample error from the parser logs: `ERROR jsonpath: unexpected token '}' at pos 142` — looks like the new parser accepts a trailing-comma extension that Lynx uses, but the older stable image rejects it.

eva (platform): Metrics: after applying routing override, 500 rate for Lynx down from 6% -> 1.2% within 90s. p95 latency for Lynx increased ~200ms due to cold starts, but overall errors trending down.

dinesh (eng-runtime): Canary rollback progressing: nodes 0->50% swapped to v1.4.2. Healthchecks passing.

ben (eng-sre): Observability note: preserve traces for all failed requests for postmortem. I'll pin the trace IDs to the incident.

alice (oncall): Canary looks stable. Proceed to full rollout?

eva (platform): Full rollback proceeding now.

dinesh (eng-runtime): Rollback complete at 17:28 UTC. Post-checks: no 5xx spikes in last 5m.

incident-bot: ACTION | Created INC-7312 for follow-up, assigned to eng-runtime. Links: runbook + incident timeline.

carla (customer-success): Lynx reports checkout errors resolved. Customer impact summary: ~12 failed orders during incident window (17:00-17:28 UTC). CS will credit affected customers and coordinate with product.

alice (oncall): Immediate mitigations done (routing override + rollback). Next actions:
- eng-runtime: add backward-compatible parsing or feature flag for trailing-comma extension (dinesh)
- eng-platform: add automated schema-compat test in release pipeline (eva)
- eng-sre: add tenant-specific canary gating for parser image rollouts (ben)
- cs: coordinate customer credits + follow-up (carla)

frank (support): I'll send the incident summary to Lynx PM and legal (as requested).

dinesh (eng-runtime): Will run a targeted test harness against Lynx's schema to reproduce. Posting initial diff + repro steps to INC-7312.

lynx-sre: Thanks team — we can repro locally. We will provide sample payloads to help add compatibility tests.

alice (oncall): Good. Closing on-call handoff: I'll file a short postmortem draft and tag owners. If anything resurfaces, re-pager.

incident-bot: THREAD CLOSED | Status: mitigated -> monitoring. Incident timeline and artifacts attached to INC-7312.
